purpose: Dataset admission audit; not a training result
admissionRequirements: Original real-vehicle audio accessible through the publisher's permitted download method
Explicit audio rights permitting the intended training and commercial app use
Per-example mechanical inspection, repair outcome or controlled-fault evidence; no AI self-label or video-title diagnosis
Vehicle, source-recording and session grouping to prevent split leakage
Model/year/engine/market scope and recording conditions documented
Independent held-out evaluation; no claim of real-world accuracy from training scores or unit fixtures

sources.evidence: Workshop diagnoses reported for selected Ford/Toyota gasoline vehicles
sources.reason: Publisher says recordings are not public due to confidentiality; no files or dataset permission obtained. Article licence is not an audio-data licence.

sources.evidence: Expert-labelled automobile fault events; 232 models reported
sources.reason: No publicly licensed audio download established in inspected paper; no files obtained.

sources.evidence: Real diesel vehicles and controlled operating/fault conditions reported
sources.reason: Data available on request; no permission or files obtained. Unsafe fault injection must not be repeated by users.
Original recording licences and per-clip mechanical confirmation not established. Public repository is not sufficient training permission.

sources.evidence: Dataset title alone is not a confirmed diagnosis
sources.reason: Public Kaggle metadata returned licenseName=Unknown; label provenance unverified.

sources.evidence: Real engine recordings by make/model/RPM; same vehicle appears across RPM folders
sources.reason: No explicit audio licence established; no mechanical health labels; many model classes have a single physical vehicle. Cannot measure unseen-vehicle recognition from random clip splits.

sources.evidence: Broad vehicle-interior sound classes from online POV recordings
sources.reason: Not diagnosed fault labels or exact model identity; underlying recording rights not established for intended use.

sources.evidence: Code for video-derived vehicle sound recognition
sources.reason: MIT code licence does not license third-party recordings. Automated labels are not confirmed mechanical diagnoses.

sources.evidence: Human-labelled sound events, not physical vehicle inspection labels
sources.reason: Mixed per-clip licences and commercial-use contact instruction. No licence clearance sought. Event labels cannot train normal/fault or exact-model judgments.
Primary download and permitted audio licence not established; no files obtained. Secondary catalogue metadata is not admission evidence.
Domain does not establish diagnosis accuracy on real cars or motorcycles.
